segment_timing: derive nominal time from target, perpendicular radius, velocity program and acceleration; live ETA from measured full-cycle progress; no implicit max_sim_s
ordering: Fresh Agent-selected wrist RGB-D and automatic grasp; original one-second hold
FIT acceleration-rich opening within current supported range
FIT different-speed closing over an overlapping measured interval
Declare a complete VALIDATION trajectory using the measured reachable interval and a distinct smooth speed profile; execute before optional expansion
Only after complete VALIDATION: optional additional FIT angular exploration if useful and time remains
Guarded release and current-state collision-checked parking within reserved resources
target_declaration: Before execution, choose endpoints inside the actually supported measured interval; check whole current-state arc, nominal duration and live episode resources. No GT dynamics. No fixed 13-degree requirement.
conditional_successors: Explicit continue_after=[SAFE_PARTIAL_PROGRESS] only, with measured-state IK/collision checks and stable transmitting stopped contact; no continuation from TRANSMISSION_FAILURE or SAFETY_STOP
fit_interruption: Predeclare time intervals; admit only the transmitting moving prefix with enough segment-local filter support. Preserve failed action status and excitation/identifiability limitations.
validation_interruption: Always exclude incomplete VALIDATION; never relabel as FIT
recovery: Use existing safe release/park and at most the registered recovery regrasp; slow Agent decisions only at an unloaded boundary
recording: FAST_DEV compact numerical 240 Hz, checkpoint RGB-D, bounded clips; raw private
